name: NAIR DEMAKE
author: MiguelGSS
description: A demake of NAIR, a fighting game with a single attack: jump, dodge and land your NAIR. Z for the NAIR in the air, X to dodge, Up to jump, Down to crouch.

descriptions.en: A demake of NAIR, a fighting game with a single attack: jump, dodge and land your NAIR. Z for the NAIR in the air, X to dodge, Up to jump, Down to crouch.
descriptions.it: Un demake di NAIR, picchiaduro con un solo attacco: salta, schiva e colpisci con la NAIR. Z per la NAIR in aria, X per schivare, su per saltare, giù per abbassarti.
